text: 你决定竞拍王冠，在纸条上写下自己的名字和合适的价格，然后把它投进箱子。你耐心等待沃伦先生宣布最高出价者。

en.title: Alone Against the Tide · 58
text: You decide to place a bid on the crown and affix your name and a suitable price to a slip of paper, which finds its way into the box. You wait patiently for Mr. Warren to announce the highest bidder.
